evidence: Traced for an `edited` delivery with `changes.base` on a bot-authored draft (self-driving) PR whose acting reviewer is opted out, in products/stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py (frozen worktree, PR #75215 @ a7fb363). Relevance gate: base_retargeted=True at tasks.py:835-838 lets `edited` through. Retarget block tasks.py:853-863 runs BEFORE any skip gate and calls _retract_approvals_on_base_retarget (tasks.py:441-480), which supersedes in-flight runs and dismisses every standing approval with _BASE_RETARGET_DISMISS_MESSAGE (tasks.py:435-438: '...Stamphog re-reviews automatically.') via dismiss_stale_approvals_for_head (logic/approvals.py:24-71, posts the message through client.dismiss_pr_review at :66). Then _review_skip_reason (tasks.py:218-236) returns 'draft' (or 'bot_author') for any self-driving PR, so the carve-out runs: _inbox_rereview_carve_out (tasks.py:144-215) admits base retargets at :167 (`if action not in _HEAD_CHANGING_ACTIONS and not base_retargeted`), and with the resolver returning None it returns _InboxCarveOut(opted_out=True) at :206-207. Back in the skip block (tasks.py:875-911): inbox_review is None, and `if action in _HEAD_CHANGING_ACTIONS` at :887 is False because _HEAD_CHANGING_ACTIONS = {'synchronize','reopened'} (tasks.py:49) excludes 'edited', so the dedicated _INBOX_OPT_OUT_DISMISS_MESSAGE (tasks.py:70-74, wired only at :897) is never posted; the task logs stamphog_pr_event_skipped reason='inbox_opt_out' (:904-908), marks the delivery processed (:909-910) and returns without queuing a run. Nothing else re-reviews: the receiver leg process_inbox_pr_review (tasks.py:1125-1245) fires only on TaskRun output saves, which a base retarget does not touch. The standing-approval precondition is real: the receiver leg upserts the PullRequest under the webhook-resolvable repo_config and creates a ReviewRun (tasks.py:1178-1230) whose workflow posts a real APPROVE (posted_review_id, temporal/activities.py:293,546,599), and test_tasks.py:796-831 sets up exactly that state (PullRequest + ReviewRun posted_review_id=9, resolver->None) for the synchronize variant and asserts the opt-out copy ('The copy must say why'). Net user-visible effect: the dismissed stamphog approval on GitHub says the PR will be re-reviewed automatically, no re-review ever runs, and the same PR on a subsequent push would instead say 'No reviewer currently has stamphog inbox reviews enabled... so stamphog will not re-review' (tasks.py:70-74) - the finding's line refs 853-860 and 887-898 are accurate. Provenance (raw `gh pr diff 75215`): _BASE_RETARGET_DISMISS_MESSAGE, _retract_approvals_on_base_retarget and the base_retargeted flag are pre-existing on master; the PR adds the carve-out, its base-retarget admission, the opted_out state, _INBOX_OPT_OUT_DISMISS_MESSAGE and the inbox_opt_out log reason. Pre-PR no bot-authored draft could hold a stamphog approval, so the mismatched state is new with this PR. Safety is not affected: the approval IS dismissed (tasks.py:470-472) and the PR simply stays unapproved, so the wrong copy hides a preference, not a safety-relevant state - consider, not should_fix. Existing tests do not cover retarget + opt-out: test_base_retarget_invalidates_same_head_approval (test_tasks.py:520-556) uses a human PR that does re-review, and test_inbox_carve_out_scope (test_tasks.py:833-872) has no base-retarget case.
notes: Would downgrade to not-real if the retarget dismissal were treated as an inherited wart: on master the same 'Stamphog re-reviews automatically.' copy already precedes every post-retarget skip that does not re-review (draft, LABEL-mode label_absent at tasks.py:941-957, disabled repo at :921-935, author_below_write at :978-990), and the PR merely adds one more skip state to that pattern - hence medium confidence. Would upgrade to should_fix if the opt-out path also failed to dismiss the approval (it does not; :853-863 dismisses first) or if the retarget copy were the only signal that a review is pending for a required-review gate someone is blocked on. The verdict would flip to not-real if `edited` were in _HEAD_CHANGING_ACTIONS AND the carve-out were resolved before :853 so the retarget sweep could carry the opt-out message, or if the base-retarget admission at carve-out :167 were removed (then retarget on a self-driving PR would skip as 'draft' with the pre-existing copy and no inbox_opt_out log, i.e. plain pre-existing behaviour).
